γαββαθα.def: of Chaldee origin (compare H1355); the knoll; gabbatha, a vernacular term for the Roman tribunal in Jerusalem. KJV: Gabbatha.

γαβριηλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1403); Gabriel, an archangel. KJV: Gabriel.

γαγγραινα.def: from γραίνω (to gnaw); an ulcer ("gangrene"). KJV: canker.

γαδ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1410); Gad, a tribe of Israelites. KJV: Gad.

γαδαρηνοσ.def: from Γαδαρά (a town east of the Jordan); a Gadarene or inhabitant of Gadara. KJV: Gadarene.

γαζα.def: of foreign origin; a treasure. KJV: treasure.
of Hebrew origin (H5804); Gazah (i.e. Azzah), a place in Palestine. KJV: Gaza.

γαζοφυλακιον.def: from γάζα (G1047) and φυλακή (G5438); a treasure-house, i.e. a court in the temple for the collection-boxes. KJV: treasury.

γαιοσ.def: of Latin origin; Gaius (i.e. Caius), a Christian. KJV: Gaius.

γαλα.def: of uncertain affinity; milk (figuratively). KJV: milk.

γαλατησ.def: from Γαλατία (G1053); a Galatian or inhabitant of Galatia. KJV: Galatian.

γαλατια.def: of foreign origin; Galatia, a region of Asia. KJV: Galatia.

γαλατικοσ.def: from Γαλατία (G1053); Galatic or relating to Galatia. KJV: of Galatia.

γαληνη.def: of uncertain derivation; tranquillity. KJV: calm.

γαλιλαια.def: of Hebrew origin (H1551); Galilæa (i.e. the heathen circle), a region of Palestine. KJV: Galilee.

γαλιλαιοσ.def: from Γαλιλαία (G1056); Galilean or belonging to Galilea. KJV: Galilean, of Galilee.

γαλλιων.def: of Latin origin; Gallion (i.e. Gallio), a Roman officer. KJV: Gallio.

γαμαλιηλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1583); Gamaliel (i.e. Gamliel), an Israelite. KJV: Gamaliel.

γαμεω.def: from γάμος (G1062); to wed (of either sex). KJV: marry (a wife).

γαμισκω.def: from γάμος (G1062); to espouse (a daughter to a husband). KJV: give in marriage.

γαμοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; nuptials. KJV: marriage, wedding.

γαρ.def: a primary particle; properly, assigning a reason (used in argument, explanation or intensification; often with other particles). KJV: and, as, because (that), but, even, for, indeed, no doubt, seeing, then, therefore, verily, what, why, yet.

γαστηρ.def: of uncertain derivation; the stomach; by analogy, the matrix; figuratively, a gourmand. KJV: belly, + with child, womb.

γε.def: a primary particle of emphasis or qualification (often used with other particles prefixed). KJV: and besides, doubtless, at least, yet.

γεδεων.def: of Hebrew origin (H1439); Gedeon (i.e. Gid(e)on), an Israelite. KJV: Gedeon (in the King James Version).

γεεννα.def: of Hebrew origin (H1516 and H2011); valley of (the son of) Hinnom; ge-henna (or Ge-Hinnom), a valley of Jerusalem, used (figuratively) as a name for the place (or state) of everlasting punishment. KJV: hell.

γεθσημανη.def: of Chaldee origin (compare H1660 and H8081); oil-press; Gethsemane, a garden near Jerusalem. KJV: Gethsemane.

γειτων.def: from γῆ (G1093); a neighbour (as adjoining one's ground); by implication, a friend. KJV: neighbour.

γελαω.def: of uncertain affinity; to laugh (as a sign of joy or satisfaction). KJV: laugh.

γελωσ.def: from γελάω (G1070); laughter (as a mark of gratification). KJV: laughter.

γεμιζω.def: transitive from γέμω (G1073); to fill entirely. KJV: fill (be) full.

γεμω.def: a primary verb; to swell out, i.e. be full. KJV: be full.

γενεα.def: from (a presumed derivative of) γένος (G1085); a generation; by implication, an age (the period or the persons). KJV: age, generation, nation, time.

γενεαλογεω.def: from γενεά (G1074) and λόγος (G3056); to reckon by generations, i.e. trace in genealogy. KJV: count by descent.

γενεαλογια.def: from the same as γενεαλογέω (G1075); tracing by generations, i.e. "genealogy". KJV: genealogy.

γενεσια.def: neuter plural of a derivative of γένεσις (G1078); birthday ceremonies. KJV: birthday.

γενεσισ.def: from the same as γενεά (G1074); nativity; figuratively, nature. KJV: generation, nature(-ral).

γενετη.def: feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of γενεά (G1074); birth. KJV: birth.

γενναω.def: from a variation of γένος (G1085); to procreate (properly, of the father, but by extension of the mother); figuratively, to regenerate. KJV: bear, beget, be born, bring forth, conceive, be delivered of, gender, make, spring.

γεννημα.def: from γεννάω (G1080); offspring; by analogy, produce (literally or figuratively). KJV: fruit, generation.

γεννησαρετ.def: of Hebrew origin (compare H3672); Gennesaret (i.e. Kinnereth), a lake and plain in Palestine. KJV: Gennesaret.

γεννητοσ.def: from γεννάω (G1080); born. KJV: they that are born.

γενοσ.def: from γίνομαι (G1096); "kin" (abstract or concrete, literal or figurative, individual or collective). KJV: born, country(-man), diversity, generation, kind(-red), nation, offspring, stock.

γεργεσηνοσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1622); a Gergesene (i.e. Girgashite) or one of the aborigines of Palestine. KJV: Gergesene.

γερουσια.def: from γέρων (G1088); the eldership, i.e. (collectively) the Jewish Sanhedrin. KJV: senate.

γερων.def: of uncertain affinity (compare γῆρας (G1094)); aged. KJV: old.

γευομαι.def: a primary verb; to taste; by implication, to eat; figuratively, to experience (good or ill). KJV: eat, taste.

γεωργεω.def: from γεωργός (G1092); to till (the soil). KJV: dress.

γεωργιον.def: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of γεωργός (G1092); cultivable, i.e. a farm. KJV: husbandry.

γεωργοσ.def: from γῆ (G1093) and the base of ἔργον (G2041); a land-worker, i.e. farmer. KJV: husbandman.

γη.def: contracted from a primary word; soil; by extension a region, or the solid part or the whole of the terrene globe (including the occupants in each application). KJV: country, earth(-ly), ground, land, world.

γηρασ.def: akin to γέρων (G1088); senility. KJV: old age.

γηρασκω.def: from γῆρας (G1094); to be senescent. KJV: be (wax) old.

γινομαι.def: a prolongation and middle voice form of a primary verb; to cause to be ("gen"-erate), i.e. (reflexively) to become (come into being), used with great latitude (literal, figurative, intensive, etc.). KJV: arise, be assembled, be(-come, -fall, -have self), be brought (to pass), (be) come (to pass), continue, be divided, draw, be ended, fall, be finished, follow, be found, be fulfilled, + God forbid, grow, happen, have, be kept, be made, be married, be ordained to be, partake, pass, be performed, be published, require, seem, be showed, X soon as it was, sound, be taken, be turned, use, wax, will, would, be wrought.

γινωσκω.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to "know" (absolutely) in a great variety of applications and with many implications (as follow, with others not thus clearly expressed). KJV: allow, be aware (of), feel, (have) know(-ledge), perceived, be resolved, can speak, be sure, understand.

γλευκοσ.def: akin to γλυκύς (G1099); sweet wine, i.e. (properly) must (fresh juice), but used of the more saccharine (and therefore highly inebriating) fermented wine. KJV: new wine.

γλυκυσ.def: of uncertain affinity; sweet (i.e. not bitter nor salt). KJV: sweet, fresh.

γλωσσα.def: of uncertain affinity; the tongue; by implication, a language (specially, one naturally unacquired). KJV: tongue.

γλωσσοκομον.def: from γλῶσσα (G1100) and the base of κόσμος (G2889); properly, a case (to keep mouthpieces of wind-instruments in) i.e. (by extension) a casket or (specially) purse. KJV: bag.

γναφευσ.def: by variation for a derivative from κνάπτω (to tease cloth); a cloth-dresser. KJV: fuller.

γνησιοσ.def: from the same as γενέσια (G1077); legitimate (of birth), i.e. genuine. KJV: own, sincerity, true.

γνησιωσ.def: adverb from γνήσιος (G1103); genuinely, i.e. really. KJV: naturally.

γνοφοσ.def: akin to νέφος (G3509); gloom (as of a storm). KJV: blackness.

γνωμη.def: from γινώσκω (G1097); cognition, i.e. (subjectively) opinion, or (objectively) resolve (counsel, consent, etc.). KJV: advice, + agree, judgment, mind, purpose, will.

γνωριζω.def: from a derivative of γινώσκω (G1097); to make known; subjectively, to know. KJV: certify, declare, make known, give to understand, do to wit, wot.

γνωσισ.def: from γινώσκω (G1097); knowing (the act), i.e. (by implication) knowledge. KJV: knowledge, science.

γνωστησ.def: from γινώσκω (G1097); a knower. KJV: expert.

γνωστοσ.def: from γινώσκω (G1097); well-known. KJV: acquaintance, (which may be) known, notable.

γογγυζω.def: of uncertain derivation; to grumble. KJV: murmur.

γογγυσμοσ.def: from γογγύζω (G1111); a grumbling. KJV: grudging, murmuring.

γογγυστησ.def: from γογγύζω (G1111); a grumbler. KJV: murmurer.

γοησ.def: from γοάω (to wail); properly, a wizard (as muttering spells), i.e. (by implication) an imposter. KJV: seducer.

γολγοθα.def: of Chaldee origin (compare H1538); the skull; Golgotha, a knoll near Jerusalem. KJV: Golgotha.

γομορρα.def: of Hebrew origin (H6017); Gomorrha (i.e. Amorah), a place near the Dead Sea. KJV: Gomorrha.

γομοσ.def: from γέμω (G1073); a load (as filling), i.e. (specially) a cargo, or (by extension) wares. KJV: burden, merchandise.

γονευσ.def: from the base of γίνομαι (G1096); a parent. KJV: parent.

γονυ.def: of uncertain affinity; the "knee". KJV: knee(X -l).

γονυπετεω.def: from a compound of γόνυ (G1119) and the alternate of πίπτω (G4098); to fall on the knee. KJV: bow the knee, kneel down.

γραμμα.def: from γράφω (G1125); a writing, i.e. a letter, note, epistle, book, etc.; plural learning. KJV: bill, learning, letter, scripture, writing, written.

γραμματευσ.def: from γράμμα (G1121). a writer, i.e. (professionally) scribe or secretary. KJV: scribe, town-clerk.

γραφη.def: from γράφω (G1125); a document, i.e. holy Writ (or its contents or a statement in it). KJV: scripture.

γραφω.def: a primary verb; to "grave", especially to write; figuratively, to describe. KJV: describe, write(-ing, -ten).

γραωδησ.def: from γραύς (an old woman) and εἶδος (G1491); crone-like, i.e. silly. KJV: old wives'.

γρηγορευω.def: from ἐγείρω (G1453); to keep awake, i.e. watch (literally or figuratively). KJV: be vigilant, wake, (be) watch(-ful).

γυμναζω.def: from γυμνός (G1131); to practise naked (in the games), i.e. train (figuratively). KJV: exercise.

γυμνασια.def: from γυμνάζω (G1128); training, i.e. (figuratively) asceticism. KJV: exercise.

γυμνητευω.def: from a derivative of γυμνός (G1131); to strip, i.e. (reflexively) go poorly clad. KJV: be naked.

γυμνοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; nude (absolute or relative, literal or figurative). KJV: naked.

γυμνοτησ.def: from γυμνός (G1131); nudity (absolute or comparative). KJV: nakedness.

γυναικαριον.def: a diminutive from γυνή (G1135); a little (i.e. foolish) woman. KJV: silly woman.

γυνη.def: probably from the base of γίνομαι (G1096); a woman; specially, a wife. KJV: wife, woman.

γωγ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1463); Gog, a symbolic name for some future Antichrist. KJV: Gog.

γωνια.def: probably akin to γόνυ (G1119); an angle. KJV: corner, quarter.
